formalAllocationControls.timingLimit: All raw ms samples, fresh-process medians/ranges and slower observations retained. Offline instrumented timings do not prove general interpreter CPU throughput.

formalSamplingInterval.limit: Formal process timestamps and root observed tool-completion UTC receipts show sampling began after completed gates/build/link; root observation is a conservative completion upper bound, not a fabricated process-end timestamp or OS trace.
